notes: Adversarial pass. Count is the whole point of this option and it is verifiably 4: four buttons in one column, evenly pitched, nothing hidden in shadow and no fifth button lurking below the crop. Single-breasted confirmed — one column only. Cross-checked against the blueprint, whose red column resolves to four marks at an even ~215px pitch (three ring marks plus a fourth lower mark on the same axis); render reproduces that same 4-up rhythm, the two welt pockets between buttons 2 and 3, and the pointed V hem. The blueprint is cropped above the neckline so it fixes no lapel geometry; the shawl lapel comes from the spec and nothing in the drawing contradicts it, so no detail was invented. Buttons are navy horn, not red — the highlight was correctly read as an identifier.
